# BatteryIncluded PHP SDK – integration guide for AI agents

> Everything needed to add BatteryIncluded search to a PHP shop with the SDK `batteryincluded/batteryincluded-php-sdk`.
> Follow the steps in order. Human-readable docs: https://sdk.batteryincluded.eiling.io/

## 0. Ask the user for

1. The collection name, always prefixed with `customer.` (e.g. `customer.my-shop`).
2. The API key of that collection. Store it in the environment or secret store, never in the repository or the browser.
3. The languages of the shop (e.g. `de`, `en`) and which language the regular product fields are in.
4. Whether the collection may be fully replaced (full import deletes all documents that are not sent).

## 1. Install

```bash
composer require batteryincluded/batteryincluded-php-sdk
```

Requirements: PHP 8.2+, extensions `curl` and `mbstring`. No further dependencies.

## 2. Create the client

```php
use BatteryIncludedSdk\Client\ApiClient;
use BatteryIncludedSdk\Client\CurlHttpClient;

$apiClient = new ApiClient(
    new CurlHttpClient(),
    'https://api.batteryincluded.io/api/v1/collections/',
    getenv('BATTERYINCLUDED_COLLECTION'), // e.g. "customer.my-shop"
    getenv('BATTERYINCLUDED_API_KEY')
);
```

Every service takes this client. Every response has `getStatusCode()`, `getBody()` (decoded array) and `getRawResponse()`.

## 3. Map the catalog to DTOs

```php
use BatteryIncludedSdk\Dto\CategoryDto;
use BatteryIncludedSdk\Dto\ProductBaseDto;
use BatteryIncludedSdk\Dto\ProductPropertyDto;

$dto = new ProductBaseDto((string) $product->id);   // exported as root id "PRODUCT-<id>", setId() is deprecated
$dto->setName($product->name);
$dto->setDescription($product->description);
$dto->setOrdernumber($product->sku);
$dto->setManufacture($product->brand);
$dto->setEan($product->ean);
$dto->setImageUrl($product->imageUrl);
$dto->setShopUrl($product->url);
$dto->setPrice((float) $product->price);
$dto->setInstock((int) $product->stock);
$dto->setRating((float) $product->rating);

// one CategoryDto per category path; the SDK exports all parent paths ("A", "A > B")
$dto->addCategory((new CategoryDto())->addCategoryNode('Electronics')->addCategoryNode('TVs'));

// property names must be language independent (e.g. always "Color"), a property can have several values
$dto->setProperties((new ProductPropertyDto())->addProperty('Color', 'Black')->addProperty('Size', '65'));
```

Blog posts: `BlogBaseDto` with `setTitle()`, `setAuthor()`, `setPublishedAt('Y-m-d')`, `setActive()`,
`setShortDescription()`, `setDescription()`, `setPreviewImage()`, `setBlogUrl()`. Stored as `BLOG-<id>` with fields in
`_BLOG`. Other content types: second constructor argument, e.g. `new BlogBaseDto('42', 'FAQ')`.

Shop-specific fields: extend `ProductBaseDto` and merge them into the type node:

```php
class ProductDto extends ProductBaseDto
{
    private ?string $material = null;

    public function setMaterial(?string $material): void
    {
        $this->material = $material;
    }

    public function jsonSerialize(): array
    {
        return array_merge_recursive(
            parent::jsonSerialize(),
            ['_' . $this->getType() => $this->filterJsonValues(['material' => $this->material])]
        );
    }
}
```

Exported document:

```json
{"id": "PRODUCT-1002", "type": "PRODUCT", "_PRODUCT": {"name": "…", "price": 699, "categories": ["Electronics", "Electronics > TVs"], "properties": [{"Color": ["Black"]}]}}
```

Filter and sort on fields with their node prefix, e.g. `_PRODUCT.price`, `_PRODUCT.properties.Color`.

## 4. Translations (multi-language shops only)

Add every language, including the language of the regular fields. Keep the regular fields filled, they are the default.

```php
$dto->addTranslation('de', 'name', 'Fernseher 65"')
    ->addTranslation('de', 'description', '…')
    ->addCategoryTranslation('de', (new CategoryDto())->addCategoryNode('Elektronik')->addCategoryNode('Fernseher'))
    ->addPropertyTranslation('de', 'Color', 'Schwarz');

$dto->addTranslation('en', 'name', 'TV 65"')
    ->addTranslation('en', 'shopUrl', 'https://shop.example/en/tv-65')
    ->addCategoryTranslation('en', (new CategoryDto())->addCategoryNode('Electronics')->addCategoryNode('TVs'))
    ->setPropertiesTranslation('en', (new ProductPropertyDto())->addProperty('Color', 'Black'));
```

- Exported as `_PRODUCT_i18n: {"de": {...}, "en": {...}}` next to `_PRODUCT`. Blog posts use `_BLOG_i18n`.
- Translatable product fields: name, description, ordernumber, manufacture, manufactureNumber, ean, imageUrl, shopUrl,
  price, instock, rating, categories, properties. Other fields throw `InvalidArgumentException`.
- Locales are normalized to lower case: `DE` → `de`, `de_CH` → `de-ch`.
- The collection needs the variable `{"name": "locale", "default": "de", "root": ["_PRODUCT_i18n", "_BLOG_i18n"]}`
  (portal → Schema → Variables). Ask the user to configure it.

## 4b. Availability (prices or status per country / sales channel only)

```php
$dto->setPrice(999.0);   // defaults stay in _PRODUCT
$dto->setActive(true);
$dto->setAvailability('de', active: true, price: 1337.0)
    ->setAvailability('ch', active: false, instock: 0);
```

- Exported as `_PRODUCT_availability: {"de": {...}, "ch": {...}}` next to `_PRODUCT`, independent of the translations.
- Allowed fields: active, price, instock. `false`/`0` overwrite the default, `null` keeps it. No fallback between scopes.
- The collection needs the variable `{"name": "availability", "default": "de", "root": ["_PRODUCT_availability"]}`.
- Request with `BrowseSearchStruct::setAvailability('ch')` (`v[availability]`); `getHits()` merges translations first,
  then the availability. Filters and sortings on `_PRODUCT.price` use the default values.

## 5. Sync

```php
use BatteryIncludedSdk\Service\SyncService;

$sync = new SyncService($apiClient);

$sync->syncOneOrManyElements(...$dtos);                 // create or replace the given documents
$sync->syncFullElements(...$dtos);                      // full import: deletes all documents not sent
$sync->partialUpdateOneOrManyElements(...$dtos);        // only the set fields, e.g. price and stock
$sync->deleteElementsByIds('PRODUCT-240', 'BLOG-2');   // root ids, prefixed with the type

// large catalogs: full import in chunks with one transaction, the last chunk finishes it
$transactionId = 'full-' . date('YmdHis');
$chunks = array_chunk($dtos, 500);
foreach ($chunks as $index => $chunk) {
    $sync->syncFullBatchElements($transactionId, $index === array_key_last($chunks), ...$chunk);
}
```

Each call returns one result per document: `[['id' => 'PRODUCT-1002', 'success' => true], …]`. Check `success`.
`null` fields are not sent; call `$dto->exportNullValues()` to clear fields with a partial update.

## 6. Configure the BatteryIncluded portal (manual, after the first sync)

The SDK cannot do this. Tell the user to configure in https://portal.batteryincluded.io:

1. Integration → Schema: mark filter fields as **Filterable**, choose their **language**, enter **label** and **unit**.
   With translations, configure each locale (e.g. `_PRODUCT_i18n › en › properties › Color`). Save schema.
2. Configuration → Filters: add the filters (translated fields use `_PRODUCT_i18n › locale › …`). Types:
   Select (Default) for properties, Select (Tree) for categories, Range for price, Rating for ratings. Order them. Save.
3. Configuration → Suggest: fields for word completion (e.g. name, ordernumber, ean) and the fields returned with
   suggested documents. Add `id`, image and url if the suggestion layer needs them. Save.
4. Configuration → Relevance → Search: searched fields with priority and typo tolerance (0 for ean/ordernumber). Save.

Without step 1 and 2 `getFacets()` is empty; without step 4 queries find nothing.

## 7. Search result page

```php
use BatteryIncludedSdk\Shop\BrowseSearchStruct;
use BatteryIncludedSdk\Shop\BrowseService;
use BatteryIncludedSdk\Shop\FacetCategoryDto;
use BatteryIncludedSdk\Shop\FacetRangeDto;
use BatteryIncludedSdk\Shop\FacetRatingDto;
use BatteryIncludedSdk\Shop\FacetSelectDto;

$search = new BrowseSearchStruct();
$search->setQuery($query);                 // empty = all documents (category pages)
$search->setLocale($language);             // sent as v[locale], always set it in multi-language shops
$search->addFilters($_GET['f'] ?? []);     // ?f[_PRODUCT.properties.Color][]=Black&f[_PRODUCT.price][from]=100&f[_PRODUCT.price][till]=500
$search->addFilter('type', 'PRODUCT');     // optional: only products
$search->setSort('_PRODUCT.price:asc');    // optional, default relevance
$search->setPerPage(24);
$search->setPage($page);

$result = (new BrowseService($apiClient))->browse($search);

$result->getFound();
$result->getPages();

foreach ($result->getHits() as $hit) {
    $document = $hit['document'];          // translations are already merged into _PRODUCT / _BLOG
    $data = $document['_' . $document['type']];
}

// pass the category field: "_PRODUCT_i18n.categories" with translations, otherwise "_PRODUCT.categories"
foreach ($result->getFacets('_PRODUCT_i18n.categories') as $facet) {
    $facet->getFieldName();                // filter key for addFilter()
    $facet->getFieldLabel();               // label from the portal
    match (true) {
        $facet instanceof FacetSelectDto => $facet->getValues(),         // FacetValueDto: getName(), getCount(), isChecked()
        $facet instanceof FacetRangeDto => [$facet->getMin(), $facet->getMax()],
        $facet instanceof FacetRatingDto => $facet->getRatings(),
        $facet instanceof FacetCategoryDto => $facet->getCategories(),  // tree: name => ['count', 'checked', 'childs']
    };
}
```

- Values of one field are combined with OR, different fields with AND. Ranges: `addRangeFilter($field, $from, $till)`.
- With translations filter on `_PRODUCT_i18n.<field>` without the locale; the gateway adds it.
- Facets without counts are skipped (the api delivers them without `type`).
- The response also contains facets of other locales (`_PRODUCT_i18n.de.properties.Color`); hide fields with a locale
  segment.
- Single document (detail page): `addFilter('id', 'PRODUCT-1002')` and `setPerPage(1)`.
- Merchandising: `getRedirectsExtensions()` (redirect to `getData()['url']`), `getTeaserExtensions()`,
  `getPromotionsExtensions()`, `getCodesExtensions()`.
- Presets: `setPresetId($id)`; list them with `(new PresetsService($apiClient))->getPresets()->getPresets()`.

## 8. Suggestions (search as you type)

```php
use BatteryIncludedSdk\Suggest\SuggestSearchStruct;
use BatteryIncludedSdk\Suggest\SuggestService;

$suggest = new SuggestSearchStruct();
$suggest->setQuery($input);
$suggest->setLocale($language);            // required: without locale the endpoint fails with HTTP 500
$suggest->setAvailability($country);       // optional, prices per country in `_PRODUCT_availability`
$suggest->addFilter('type', 'PRODUCT');

$response = (new SuggestService($apiClient))->suggestWithFilter($suggest);

$response->getQueryCompletions();          // CompletionDto: getValue(), getHighlighted()
$response->getDocuments();                 // only the fields selected in the portal; translated fields stay in _PRODUCT_i18n
$response->getFounds();
```

Escape all output except `<mark>` tags of highlighted values. Call the endpoint server side (API key!), e.g. from a
small JSON endpoint that the browser queries with a debounce of ~150 ms and a minimum of 2 characters.

Further services: `SimilarSearchService::search($query, $locale)`, `HighlightsService::getHighlights()`,
`RecommendationsService::recommendByIdentifier('1002')` and
`CartRecommendationsService::recommendByIdentifiers(['1002', '1003'])` (both grouped in `related`, `also`, `together`).

## 9. Verify

1. Sync a few products and check `success` in the response.
2. Browse without query: `getFound()` equals the number of synced documents.
3. Browse with a query from a product name: the product is found (otherwise check Relevance → Search).
4. `getFacets()` returns the configured filters with labels (otherwise check Schema → Filterable and Filters).
5. Multi-language: browse with each locale and compare `_PRODUCT.name` in `getHits()`.
6. Suggest with two characters of a product name returns documents.

## Pitfalls

- Full imports (`syncFullElements`, finished batch) delete every document not sent.
- Always send the locale in multi-language shops; the gateway has no fallback for missing translations, the regular
  fields in `_PRODUCT` are the default.
- Availability overrides only change the delivered hits; `_PRODUCT.price` filters and sortings use the defaults.
- Facets exist only after the portal configuration; the SDK cannot create them.
- Never expose the API key to the browser; proxy suggest requests through your backend.
- Reference implementation: the demo shop in `examples/` of the repository (`index.php`, `detail.php`, `api/suggest.php`).
